item.text: {"commentary":"Claim the nearby villages while building a force that can break enemy garrisons. Spending 11 stars on three hunts and a mine supplies the capital’s five missing population for a Giant; a fresh action list will let us deploy it and reassess newly revealed terrain.","actions":[9,20,42,10,17,36,29],"notes":"If the level-up produces a Giant, deploy it northeast toward the villages and eventual enemy cities. Warrior #1 is moving onto (11,13) for capture next turn; #11 approaches (10,10), while #7 supports eastern expansion. Capital currently faces no visible immediate threat. Locate enemy cities before choosing a siege; use the Giant to break garrisons and healthy Warriors to occupy."}
